release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.11 strengthens the postflop CPU BOT with GTO-inspired bet sizing and polarized range selection. The response model now measures a raise using the incremental raise over the pot after call, not the hero's combined call-plus-raise spend. Routine flop and multiway bets use smaller size menus; overbets require suitable nut advantage, street, SPR and made-hand strength. Bets of 75% pot or larger use a polarized selection: strong value or blocker-qualified low-showdown-value bluffs, while medium-strength showdown-value hands remain in the check/call region. Large multiway bluffs are blocked and large multiway value requires exceptional nutted conditions. The immutable 174-situation preflop policy is unchanged.
